current_focus.summary: Commerce records exact EmDash 0.35.0 as its scaffold development baseline. The repository remains private at 0.0.0 with no installable runtime or compatibility promise; the atomic product/SKU write grill follows separately.

decisions.choice: Use exact EmDash 0.35.0 as a development-only dependency with a lockfile; do not add a peer/runtime compatibility claim until a real Commerce adapter and fixture exist.

recommendation.reason: The public scaffold now has an exact current-stable build baseline; the next unresolved correctness boundary is preventing two server copies from accepting the same SKU concurrently.
